notes.title: New map Warsaw
notes.content:
New Map – Warsaw:
- Explore a brand-new large office with two levels and multiple small offices!
- Community Art – Winning artwork from the recent contest has been added throughout the office!

Improved Assistant:
- The assistant can now access a camera and take photos around the office.
- New TV in the Manager’s Office – The assistant can upload pictures from the camera to the TV, and show them to the manager.

New Sub-Role: Analyst:
- During meetings, analysts can go up to the easel and compare two players.
- A statistics window will appear, comparing the players based on a random metric like how much time they have spent on their computers.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
:
- Added a confirmation prompt: "Do you really want to end the meeting?"
- Enhanced the Customization Menu.
- Fixed an issue where keybinds were not being saved between sessions.
- Fixed an issue where duplicate players could spawn.
- Desk Marker: Your workstation is now clearly marked on the HUD for easier navigation.
- Game Statistics: You can now view statistics from the main menu.
- Character Photography: You can now take a picture of your character which will be saved to your computer.
- Role explanation - During meetings, you will now receive a hint about your role and its abilities.

Thank you for all the support and the amazing artwork that made the new map even more fun!🎨

notes.title: Valentines Update
notes.content:
New Content and Features:
- Slackers are now immune to viruses during meetings and for the first minute after starting the game.
- Hidden windows can now be recentered by opening it again.
- Janitor can't vote for new manager
Valentines day:
- Added new glasses.
- Added additional decor to the Berlin map.
- New Proposal Emote added.
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where assistants were not being demoted properly.
- Documents now keep their correct names after being copied and inserted into a binder.
- Resolved an issue where players could spawn without a task when the "Slacker can't see other slackers" setting was enabled.
- Fixed a bug where no players would appear on the whiteboard.
- Corrected a missing label for workstation usage.
- Workstations will now reset if a player leaves the game.

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes & Improvements:  

   - Improved Anti-Cheat: Enhanced security measures to prevent exploits and unfair gameplay.  

   - Spectator Chat Restriction: Spectators can now only send text messages to other spectators.  
integrity.  

   - Performance Fixes:  
     - The game no longer freezes when playing a CD.  
     - The game no longer freezes when lighting a trash bin on fire.  

   - Item Handling Fixes:  
     - Fixed a bug that allowed items to get stuck after a handshake.  
     - Loose items now sync better across all players.  
     - Players can no longer grab multiple mice at the same time.  

   - Exploit Fixes:  
     - The handshake can no longer be used to teleport.  

   - Reward System Fix: The wrong reward bug has been corrected.  

New Features:  

   - Body Size Customization: Players can now adjust their character’s body size for more personalization.  

   - Dedicated Player Management Menu: A new menu has been added for selecting players to **fire, protect, call, or assign desks.**  

   - New Emote - "Flip Off": A brand-new emote has been added, allowing players to express themselves in a new way.  

Thank you for all your feedback and support! More updates are on the way! 🚀

notes.title: HR Rep Update
notes.content:
Anti-Cheat Improvements:

   - The anti-cheat system has been improved to enhance fair gameplay and security.

New Role Added - HR:

   - HR Role: A brand-new HR role has been introduced to the game.
   - HR can protect a player from being fired, adding a strategic element to gameplay.
   - Players can take on the HR role whether they are a Slacker or a Specialist.

New Features:

   - Chat Bubbles: 
     - Players can now chat with each other! Messages are only visible to those in the same room for added immersion.
     - You'll receive notifications in chat when a player leaves the game.

New Task:

   - Knock on the Fish Tank: A fun new task has been added to interact with the office fish.

Reward System Revamp:

   - The in-game rewarding system has been improved for better balance and progression.
   - Players can now purchase in-game currency once again.

New Customizations:

   - Eyes: 
     - Eye customization is now available.
     - A new red eye color option has been added.

   - Hairstyles: 
     - Six new hairstyles have been introduced for more variety.

   - Eyebrows: 
     - A brand-new eyebrow style has been added for further personalization.

   - Clothing: 
     - Two new shirt designs to choose from.
     - Hoodies and sweatshirts have been added to the wardrobe.
     - New pants options are available.
     - Four new shoe styles to customize your character's look.

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements:

   - Object Spawn Fix: Objects now spawn correctly in the center.
   - Performance Enhancements: Various optimizations have been made to improve gameplay performance and stability.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Task Update
notes.content:
New Year Greetings and Announcements:

   - First off, we want to wish you all a Happy New Year! 🎉 To kick things off, we’ve got some exciting new updates for you!

New Content and Features:

   - New Map - "Berlin, Germany": Explore the brand-new office map for a fresh gaming experience, now featuring an office fish tank!

   - MeowTube Integration: You can now watch MeowTube directly on your in-game PC for added fun.

   - Player Role ID Card: Your work profile now comes with a sleek and professional ID card.

   - Improved Lighting: More realistic lighting has been added to dynamic objects for enhanced immersion.

   - New Achievement Added: Unlock a brand-new achievement!

   - Customization Additions: Two new hairstyles have been added to personalize your character.

New Tasks:

   - Specialist Tasks: 
     - Feeding the fish: Ensure the office fish get their food, or they may not survive!
     - Make coffee for the manager.
     - Call client: A fully interactive mechanic where you use your desk phone and mic for dynamic conversations.
     - Update your PC: Load updates using a floppy disk.
     - Sheetly Task: Update a cell using a brand-new program on your PC.

   - Slacker Tasks: 
     - Poison the fish with ink (black task).
     - Draw on the bathroom mirror.
     - Turn off someone’s firewall.
     - Drink water from the water cooler.
     - Watch MeowTube on your PC for 10 seconds.

Settings and User Interface Enhancements:

   - New Layout for Settings: Enjoy a more organized and intuitive settings menu.
   - Task Management: You can now disable tasks you don’t want to appear in the game.
   - Role-Specific Settings: Customize settings based on player roles.
   - Detailed Descriptions: Every setting now has a clear explanation for better usability.

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements:

   - Big Name in Game Fix: Player names are now properly scaled to avoid overlapping.
   - Updated QR Code: The in-game QR code for Discord has been updated.
   - Achievement Fixes: "The Crazy Colleague," "Changed My Mind," and "This Will Go to HR" achievements are now working correctly.
   - Fire Extinguisher Fix: Fire extinguishers will now respawn and cannot be hidden indefinitely.
   - Desk Interaction Fix: Players can now reliably interact with desks.
   - Scaling Issues Resolved: Various scaling problems have been fixed.
   - And many more minor bug fixes to enhance gameplay stability.

Other Announcements:

   - Translation Updates: Translation work is ongoing, and a beta version is available with more updates coming soon.

Thank you for all your support and the amazing ideas you’ve shared with us! We've carefully saved your suggestions and look forward to bringing even more exciting updates in the future.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
New Content and Features:

   - Halloween Task: A new seasonal task has been added for the Halloween season!
   
   - Map Decorations: The "Coolest Office/The Spookiest Office" map now features Halloween-themed decor to celebrate the season.
   
   - Halloween Cosmetics: Customize your character with exclusive Halloween outfits and accessories, perfect for the spooky festivities.
   
   - Lobby Music: Halloween-themed music has been added to the lobby for an immersive seasonal experience.

   - Color Code on F-Wheel: We’ve added color coding to the F-Wheel, enhancing navigation and usability.

   - PC Mouse Indicator: PC players will now see a mouse indicator, improving playability and control.

   - Display Update Log: Recent update changes are now displayed on the main menu, making it easier to view update details quickly.

   - Arabic Language Support: The game now includes Arabic translations, expanding accessibility for a wider player base.

New Gameplay Elements:

   - Key Usage Setting: A new option in Game Settings lets you toggle a limit for keys on locked doors, adding more control to gameplay.

   - Lobby Music Control: You can now adjust the volume of lobby music, including a mute option for added convenience.

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements:

   - Janitor Bug Fix: The janitor bug has been fixed, improving game consistency.

   - Achievement Fixes: We have addressed most issues with achievements, with some additional fixes in progress.



We hope you enjoy the Halloween update and these new features! Your feedback is invaluable, so please share your thoughts as we continue to improve the game.

notes.title: Emotes & Hats Update
notes.content:
New Content and Features:

    - Finnish Translations: The game now includes full Finnish translations, further expanding our support for international players.
    
    - Community Shirts: We’ve added a collection of community-designed shirts.
    
    - Hats: Your character can now wear hats. 

    - Emotes: Players can now perform emotes in the game using an emote wheel. Default keybind is 'G'.
    
    - Vocal Chat for Spectators: Players who are spectating can now see each other and talk to each other. 
    
    - Additional Steam Achievements: We've added more Steam achievements for you to unlock as you complete various challenges.

New Gameplay Elements:

    - Set Number of Janitors: You can now set the number of janitors working in your facility, giving you more control over cleaning efficiency. If it's set to 3, the first 3 fired players will become janitors.
    
Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements:

    - Drunk Effect Setting: A new setting has been introduced to disable the drunk effect and reduce motion sickness, providing a more comfortable experience for players prone to motion-related discomfort.
    
    - General Bug Fixes: We have addressed several bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.



We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep sharing your thoughts as we continue to enhance the game. Thank you for being part of our community!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Viral multiplayer hit Dale and Dawson heads outdoors in new update
notes.content:
While we saw a huge flood of social deduction multiplayer games after the huge lockdown success of Among Us, none have charmed me quite so much as newcomer Dale and Dawson Stationery Supplies. Released in August by Striped Panda Studios, it tasks one player with managing an office and attempting to root out potential slackers in the pursuit of productivity. Having already proved popular on YouTube and Twitch, a new Dale and Dawson update adds control options and lets you take matters outside.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: New Map: Stockholm
notes.content:
New Features

 Improved Translations: All game text has been fully translated into all supported languages, improving the experience for players around the world.

New Map - Exterior: A new exterior map has been added, allowing players to explore outside the office for new gameplay opportunities.

Firmware Update Specialist Task: Specialists can now update the firmware of security cameras, disabling them for 30 seconds. Slackers can use this to temporarily block surveillance.

Character Customization Presets: You can now choose preset customizations and set a character name that will be displayed in-game.

New Song for the Stereo: A new song has been added, which can be played using CDs found in the CD rack.

Assistant Unlocks Infected Computers: Assistants now have the ability to unlock computers that have been infected by viruses.

Custom Keybinds: You can now customize every keybind to fit your preferred setup.

Mouse Inversion Options: Players can now invert the mouse on separate axes, giving more control over the mouse movement. 

Bug Fixes

 General Bug Fixes: Several bugs have been fixed to improve the overall stability and performance of the game. 

Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support!

notes.title: CCTV Update
notes.content:
New Features


CCTV:
There are now 4 security cameras in each office that the manager can watch from their computer.
This feature can be enabled in the game rules.

Applauding:
Players can now applaud while sitting on chairs.

Censor Offensive Words:
You can now choose to locally censor offensive words in the settings.


Bug Fixes:


Sticky Notes:
Sticky notes now adhere better to people, improving usability.


Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support!

notes.title: Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies - Copenhagen Update
notes.content:
New Features


New Map:
- A brand-new location "Copenhagen" has been added! Explore and discover new challenges.

3 New Hair Colors:
- Blue
- Green
- Pink

Player Moderation:
- You can now kick and mute players directly in-game by pressing the Escape key.

New Resolution Support:
- Added support for 5120x1440 ultrawide resolution.


Bug Fixes:


Fixed an issue where players could hide items in sofas and toilets:
- Items can no longer be hidden in sofas or toilets.

Double grab items:
- Players can no longer grab two items simultaneously.
- Fire extinguishers and cat food can no longer be stacked on top of each other.

Fire manager timer paused in meeting:
- The timer will now pause when a manager starts a meeting.

No cigarette pack count:
- You can no longer spam cigarette boxes from your desk.

Spamming icons is no more possible:
- Spamming icons on your desktop is now disabled.

Single mouse limitation:
- You can now only have one mouse connected to the computer at any given time.

Change microphone input:
- You can now change your microphone input in the settings.

Document not spawning on desktop:
- You can now only have one copy of each document on your desktop at a time.


Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support!

notes.title: 🛠️ Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies - Game Update 1.0.7 🛠️
notes.content:
New Features:


Limited Consumable Items:
- Now there is an unspecified limit to the amount of, for example, apples that can exist in the world.
   So you have to consume or throw away consumable items to get new ones.

Elevator Update:
- You can now use the elevator while holding objects without dropping them.
- We have tried to fix the problem where people randomly start to fly or fall in the map.


Bug Fixes:


Paint Improvements:
- Now, if you have image censoring enabled, you won't see anything that people are drawing on the paint application on their computers.

Joining the Tutorial:
- Fixed an issue where you could not launch the tutorial on your first try.


Thank you for all the feedback we're receiving!

notes.title: 🛠️ Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies - Game Update 1.0.6 🛠️
notes.content:
New Features:


Limit Player Count in Lobbies:
- When creating a lobby, you can now set a maximum player limit.

Lobby Privacy Settings:
- You can now change your lobby type between "Closed," "Private," and "Public" at any time.

Blacklist Players from Lobbies:
- After kicking a player from your lobby, you now have the option to blacklist them, preventing them from rejoining that specific lobby.

Hiding Printed Images
- This setting allows you to hide all content on printed images.


Gameplay Improvements:


Invert Mouse Settings:
- Added an option in the settings menu to invert your mouse controls.

Shortened Assistant Animations:
- Reduced the animation time for the assistant from 4 seconds to 2 seconds when someone is prompted.

Removed Region-Locked Lobbies:
- All region restrictions have been removed, allowing you to see and join all available lobbies globally.

Managers Tag Always Visible
- This improvement adds a constant [Manager] tag under the manager's name.

Improved HUD
- We fixed an issue related to the HUD disappearing after a meeting.

Slackers can't see slackers
- We fixed an issue where the lobby settings to hide slackers from each other did not apply.


Thank you for all the feedback we're receiving!

notes.title: Game Update Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
What’s New:


🔄 Restart Game Lobbies: After a game finishes, the host of the lobby will now have the option to restart the same lobby. Making it easier to jump into the next round without any hassle.


 ⏸️ Fire Manager Timer Pause: During meetings, the 'Fire Manager' Timer will now pause, giving you more control and time to make crucial decisions.


 🎤 Microphone Selection: You can now choose your preferred microphone directly from the game settings, ensuring a better in-game communication experience.


 🔧 Improved Lobby Functionality: We’ve made improvements to the lobby system. You should now be able to join games using codes, and the lobby browser should be functioning better, though we’re still working on further refinements.


These updates are designed to enhance your game play experience, making everything run smoother and more efficiently. We’re always working to improve the game, so if you have any feedback or run into issues, please let us know by Creating a ticket.

Thank you for your continued support—see you in the game!

notes.title: One Week Until Launch! Thank You for Your Incredible Support!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re just one week away from the release of Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies! I want to personally thank all of you for your support throughout this journey. It’s been an incredible experience, and I’m excited to finally share the game with you.

Launch Details:
Release Date: 30/8
Maps: At launch, you’ll be able to play on three unique maps. Plus, there’s another map in the works that will be released soon after launch.
Regular Updates: This is just the beginning. Expect regular updates post-launch with new content and improvements to keep the game fresh and exciting.
Join Us for the Launch Stream:
To celebrate the launch, we’ll be hosting a live stream on Twitch. Join us for gameplay, Q&A, and more. It’s the perfect way to kick off the release and get into the game with the community.

Connect with Other Players:
If you’re looking for people to play with, head over to our Discord. Whether you have friends to play with or not, you can find others who are ready to jump into the action. Our community is active and welcoming—perfect for finding your next gaming group.

Stay Connected:
Discord
Twitch
Instagram
TikTok
Youtube

Thank you for your support. I can’t wait to see you all in-game next week!

See you on launch day,

Jakob Forsbacka
Creator of Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies
